x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) define the organizational routing structure Now Assist uses for intelligent HR case assignment. Without COEs, Now Assist cannot provide department-aware AI routing.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Configure HR COEs aligned to your HR organizational structure via sn_hr_core_coe_list.do. Assign HR services to appropriate COEs. Target: 3+ active COEs. Now Assist HRSD uses COE structure for AI-driven case routing recommendations.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) define the organizational routing structure Now Assist uses for intelligent HR case assignment. Without COEs, Now Assist cannot provide department-aware AI routing.]]></ai_justification><check_name>HR COE Configuration</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function() {
    try {
        if (!gs.tableExists("sn_hr_core_coe")) {
            return { status: "not_applicable", actualValue: "HR COE table not found", finding: "HR Centers of Excellence table does not exist on this instance." };
        }
        var ga = new GlideAggregate("sn_hr_core_coe");
        ga.addQuery("active", true);
        ga.addAggregate("COUNT");
        ga.query();
        var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")) : 0;
        var actualValue = count + " active HR Centers of Excellence";
        if (count >= 3) {
            return { status: "ready", actualValue: actualValue, finding: count + " active HR COEs. Now Assist HRSD can provide department-aware AI case routing based on COE structure." };
        } else if (count >= 1) {
            return { status: "needs_attention", actualValue: actualValue, finding: "Only " + count + " active HR COE(s) (target: 3+). Now Assist HRSD routing will have limited organizational differentiation." };
        } else {
            return { status: "not_ready", actualValue: actualValue, finding: "No active HR COEs configured. COEs define the routing structure Now Assist uses for intelligent HR case assignment." };
        }
    } catch(e) {
        return { status: "verification_needed", actualValue: "Check failed", finding: "Script execution error: " + e.message };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>HRSD</module><number>CHK0002595</number><order>120</order><remediation_guidance>Configure HR COEs aligned to your HR organizational structure via sn_hr_core_coe_list.do.
